subject: To ShinyApps team: any plans to offer granular admin user permissions (ie on a per app basis)

messages.author: 53626e29c26886b6
messages.subject: To ShinyApps team: any plans to offer granular admin user permissions (ie on a per app basis)
parts:
I'm working on setting up a shinyapps app for a client via shinyapps.io. I want to delegate password management to them, (I'm on shinyapps.io Professional plan).

Currently I think the only option is to add one of their users as a member of my shinyapps account, but that would allow them access to all my apps.

I can't see a way to give them ShinyApps admin rights just for a single app. Are there any current or planned solutions to this?

Related - is there any way to automate / get an API into user management rather than have to go into ShinyApps.io admin console? I'd like to just feed a file of user / apps names in to minimize the manual work.

Thanks!

Mark

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] To ShinyApps team: any plans to offer granular admin user permissions (ie on a per app basis)
parts:
Mark,

Currently, any account members will have access to all applications. We do not have any finer granularity for permissions at this time. This is something we could look at adding in the future if we get a lot of requests for it.

As for the programmatically adding users, you can use the following functions from the shinyapps or rsconnect package:

addAuthorizedUser()
removeAuthorizedUser()
showUsers()
showInvited()

Please make sure you're running the latest version of the package.

Hope that helps,
-Andy
